description.value: The Cockpit is a cafe located within the Harbour Air seaplane terminal in downtown Vancouver, one of the world's largest all-seaplane airline hubs serving destinations across BC and the Pacific Northwest. Situated at basement level (level -1) inside the terminal building, it serves travellers and visitors passing through the waterfront facility. Touring cyclists in the Coal Harbour area may find it a convenient stop, though access requires locking bikes outside and entering the terminal.

address.value: 1075 W Waterfront Rd, Vancouver, BC, Canada
